answer: Each identity must stake 300 saffron tokens locked for 25 epochs against a hardware credential. An attacker minting N fakes locks 300N tokens and forfeits 80 percent of stake per proven fraud after a 3-epoch challenge window. Splitting identities multiplies that lock and penalty by N, while independent jurors scan the registry's canyon of attestation records and flag duplicates, so each fake costs a yarrow of real capital.
